text: Việt Nam-China border gate pair upgraded to international status

LAI CHÂU - Việt Nam's northern province of Lai Châu and China's Yunnan province held a ceremony on Tuesday to announce the upgrade of the Ma Lù Thàng (Việt Nam) - Jinshuihe (China) pair of border gates to international status.
The milestone marks a new stage in economic and trade cooperation and friendly exchanges between the two localities.

Speaking at the event, Vice Chairman of the People's Committee of Lai Châu Hà Trọng Hải said that the upgrade reflects the attention and direction of the two countries' governments, as well as close and responsible coordination among ministries, agencies and sectors and the authorities of Lai Châu and Yunnan provinces.
The event will not only strengthen friendship and cooperation between the two localities but also create new development opportunities and momentum for the border area.

It will facilitate import and export activities and cross-border travel, attract investment, promote trade, services, tourism and logistics, and enhance connectivity between Việt Nam's northwestern region and Yunnan province and other localities in southwestern China, he said.

To ensure the effective operation of the international border gates, Hải urged authorities and relevant agencies on both sides to further strengthen cooperation, maintain effective regular exchanges and talks, proactively share information and coordinate in promptly addressing emerging difficulties and obstacles, thereby ensuring stable, smooth and convenient border-gate operations in accordance with each country's laws.

He also called for stronger administrative reforms and the application of information technology and digital transformation in border-gate management and operations, along with stronger coordination in border management and protection and in combating crime, smuggling and trade fraud.

Hải affirmed that Lai Châu will continue to direct its departments, sectors and local authorities to proactively coordinate with central agencies and Yunnan province in managing and operating the border gates.
The province will strive to turn the Ma Lù Thàng - Jinshuihe international border gate pair into a key trade hub, contributing to the socioeconomic development of both localities.

Wang Jialing, Deputy Secretary of the Party Committee and Acting Governor of Honghe prefecture, expressed her hope for continued cooperation to promote border-gate economic activities, trade in goods and friendly exchanges between people living on both sides of the border. - VNA/VNS
